name: Blood+ Final Piece ~Saigo no Kakera~
original_name: BLOOD+ ファイナルピース〜最後のかけら〜
source: An animated adventure game with subtitles in the vein of titles like Double Cast where the player can follow new stories about Saya and the Blood+ universe. Includes full voice acting, new stories and characters not included in the TV series and special features.
translation: 一款类似《Double Cast》的带字幕动画冒险游戏，玩家可以体验小夜与《BLOOD+》世界中的全新故事。游戏包含全程配音、电视动画未曾出现的新剧情与新角色，以及特别内容。
